statute: Food Safety and Standards (Ayurveda Aahar) Regulations, 2022
authority: Food Safety and Standards Authority of India (FSSAI)
title: Prior Approval for Novel Formulations and Labelling Requirements
content:
Regulation 8 establishes an Expert Committee under FSSAI and Ministry of AYUSH to evaluate new Ayurveda Aahar products.
If an innovator creates a novel food product incorporating Ayurvedic botanicals not directly matching classical recipes:
1. Prior approval of FSSAI is mandatory before manufacturing or marketing.
2. Submissions must demonstrate historical safe dietary usage.
3. Clear advisory warning labels: 'For dietary use only — not for medicinal use' and 'Not recommended for infants below 24 months'.
